# docs-notary

> A documentation system for repositories whose primary reader is an AI agent. Docs are tiered by
> authority (reference / product / engineering / plans / archive), every file carries validated YAML
> frontmatter, an agent-readable index (docs/index.json) is generated, and a blocking gate keeps all
> of it true. The core field is `status: reference` — it makes "not a commitment" machine-detectable,
> so an agent never implements a captured competitor spec as if it were committed scope.

Install: `npm install -D @puralex/docs-notary`, then `npx docs-notary init` (greenfield) or the
migration procedure in the `docs-adopt` skill (existing tree). Claude Code plugin:
`/plugin marketplace add magnifito/docs-notary`.

Agent rule for any repo using this system: read `docs/index.json` first and filter by `kind` and
`status`; never grep `docs/` blind. Nothing with `status: reference` may be implemented directly —
promote it into `product/` first.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/magnifito/docs-notary/blob/main/README.md): what you get, the
  default tiers, the frontmatter schema, the rule table with each rule's default severity, install
  routes.
- [skills/](https://github.com/magnifito/docs-notary/tree/main/skills): the agent-facing
  procedure, five skills, each self-contained and triggered by the situation an agent is in:
  `docs-adopt` (no `docs/index.json` yet: survey, migrate, wire the gate), `docs-sort` (a document
  another tool wrote under a path no tier knows, or with no frontmatter: file it by authority with
  `mv --adopt`), `docs-promote` (change a document's authority or place; the prose rewrite no
  command can do), `docs-audit` (are these docs still true: `advisory`, `verify`, `impact`, then
  restamp, rewrite or archive), `docs-gate` (`check-docs FAILED`: one fix per rule id, never a
  severity change).
- [Design](https://github.com/magnifito/docs-notary/blob/main/docs/engineering/design.md): the
  full design — the problem, rejected alternatives, what the gate deliberately does not assert.

## Package

- [npm: @puralex/docs-notary](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@puralex/docs-notary): CLI commands
  `init` (greenfield tree), `new <path>` (a gate-clean document), `mv <from> <to>` (promotion: move,
  restamp, record `promoted_from`; `--adopt` stamps frontmatter on a stray that has none),
  `check` (the blocking gate; `--json`, `--format github`, `--base <ref>` for the history-aware
  rules), `verify` (runs command evidence, hashes path evidence,
  `--stamp` sets `verified_on`), `impact` (which documents claim the changed paths), `context` and
  `export` (documents with an authority banner; JSONL per heading for RAG), `gen`, `fix`, `advisory`,
  `migrate`. Node 20+, one dependency (`yaml`).
- [GitHub](https://github.com/magnifito/docs-notary): Apache-2.0.
